_note: SAMPLE for UI building only. Shapes match types/index.ts exactly. Values are illustrative; real values come from npm run load.

rows.brief_problem: A good salesperson has left or keeps missing shifts
Too few people on the floor on busy days
Walk-ins steady but fewer of them buying
rows.reason: No store had steady walk-ins and a conversion drop at least 1 point worse than both city and state peers, statistically real (z of 2 or more) and not already explained by a more specific cause.

rows.brief_problem: A whole city slowing down (a market problem, not one store's)
rows.reason: No city lost 8% or more of its walk-ins against the rest of the fleet in the last 28 days with every store down and the same weeks last year flat.

rows.brief_problem: Salespeople not adding the obvious pair
A salesperson avoiding a category their city buys
rows.reason: No active salesperson sold a category on half or less of their city's share (z of −4 or lower).

rows.brief_problem: Discounts well above the store's norm
Stores or salespeople whose customers don't come back
rows.reason: No active salesperson's repeat rate was far below the rest of their store (z of −4 or lower, 150+ customers).

rows.brief_problem: Role models whose customers do come back
rows.reason: No active salesperson's customers came back at twice the rest of their store (z of 5 or more).
Diwali 2025-10-20: bills per day -8% vs the 3 weeks before; ±3 days left out of baselines. A normal festival swing, not an alert.

rows.brief_problem: A number that can't be right: data issue, no alert
rows.reason: PAT-03: 11 store-days with more bills than walk-ins; those days are left out of conversion. Data issue, no alert.

rows.brief_problem: Brand-new store: no fair baseline yet
rows.reason: BLR-05: Opened 2026-10-10: too new to judge, left out of peer comparisons. Data issue, no alert.

rows.brief_problem: Staff with no exit date: 'left' read from the roster only
rows.reason: 9 salespeople (BLR-02, BLR-03, BLR-04, KNP-03, LKO-01, LKO-02, PAT-04) dropped off the roster 21+ days before the as-of date. No exit date is recorded, so "left" is read from the roster only (mentor rule). No alert.
